description:
Born in the 1800s with a rare condition that gave him a distinctive tapered head, William Henry Johnson became known to audiences as “Zip the Pinhead.” After growing up in poverty, he was eventually discovered and exhibited in traveling shows where crowds were fascinated by his unusual appearance.

Despite being presented as a curiosity during the circus and sideshow era, Zip became one of the most famous performers of his time and helped shape the history of early American entertainment.
